description: This source file contains platform-specific upgrade and check functions for OpenWrt firmware, tailored to various device boards such as Banana Pi BPI-R64, Buffalo WSR series, D-Link, and others. It defines functions for upgrading firmware images, checking image validity, and copying configuration based on the device type.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Handles firmware upgrade process for different device boards based on their specific characteristics.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Validates firmware images before upgrade depending on device-specific criteria.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Copies device-specific boot and partition configuration during setup.
